subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Dick Van Dyke Show's Wit
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Dick Van Dyke Show's Wit.

hook.text: Carl Reiner created a show about a comedy writer's life. Nobody wanted it until he recast the lead.

buildup.text: Dick Van Dyke played Rob Petrie, a writer for a fictional TV show. The humor was smart, fast, and self-aware.

discovery.text: Mary Tyler Moore played Laura Petrie and wore capri pants, shocking sponsors who demanded skirts on women.

twist.text: The show depicted a married couple who actually liked each other. In 1960s TV, that was quietly revolutionary.

climax.text: It merged workplace comedy with domestic comedy—a hybrid format that would dominate television for 50 years.

punchline.text: The smartest sitcom trick was making marriage funny.

quiz.question: What format innovation did The Dick Van Dyke Show pioneer?
